suite: Production spelling content script with a local storage adapter

checks.name: Enables the real search field and keeps native corrections and result text
Shortcut explicitly uses All, preserves language/SafeSearch and drops verbatim/pagination
Typing updates spelling target and safely encodes symbols and Japanese
Japanese helper labels update without changing the search text
Replaced search fields are enhanced and only one helper survives DOM updates
Master pause restores original spellcheck attributes and removes the helper immediately
Independent spelling switch restores the field and can resume
All view preserves spellcheck but omits the redundant spelling shortcut
No automatic spelling request or uncaught script errors

limitations: Fixtures use localhost and a browser-storage adapter; not evidence of live Google layout or native dictionary suggestions.
No spelling shortcut is followed and no query is sent to Google by this test.
